Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: otter character model sheet.
Using character #1 (otter, top-left) from the attached sheet as the exact reference. Keep the same face, proportions, orange headband AND orange wristband. Preserve the small round ears, broad cream muzzle, large expressive eyes, compact upright body, short limbs, and long tapered tail.
Refinements: warmer, richer brown body; lighter cream belly and muzzle; paws one tone lighter than the body so they read against it. Orange sport accessories #FF7A1F.
Create one landscape character model sheet for 2D rig animation (Rive), 1536×1024 or higher with the same 3-row composition for direct comparison with a companion sheet.
Use the attached eight-candidates.png as the visual identity reference; render ONLY the specified animal throughout this new sheet.
Layout: exactly THREE horizontal rows. Even spacing within each row, generous clear margins, complete unclipped characters, no overlapping cells. Row 1 has FOUR full-body turnaround views from left to right: front, 3/4, side, back. Row 2 has EIGHT equally sized HEAD-ONLY expressions from left to right: neutral, happy, excited, proud, sleepy, thinking, surprised, gently concerned. Row 3 has SEVEN full-body key poses from left to right: waving hello, thumbs up, jumping with joy (tail swinging), sitting and waiting, holding a clipboard, stretching, resting. All 19 drawings must be present. Resting is a relaxed reclining pose distinct from sitting and waiting. Show the thumb clearly in the thumbs-up pose; keep the clipboard simple and blank.
Maintain one consistent identity, facial anatomy, body proportions, markings, colors and sporty accessories in all views and poses. Preserve the source character's adult confident slightly playful energy, not babyish. Emotions must be distinct through eyelids, eyes and mouth and readable as small app icons. Keep broad simple separable body parts, rounded primitives, clear limb/body boundaries for a future rig.
Flat vector style, simple rounded primitive shapes, perfectly uniform flat fills, no textures, no fur strands, no gradients, no 3D shading. Use the same clean mostly outline-free style across the entire sheet. Plain uniform warm off-white background. NO TEXT of any kind: no labels, letters, numbers, captions, titles or watermarks; no grid lines.

Edit Image 1, the OTTER model sheet. Image 2, eight-candidates.png, is supporting identity reference for otter #1 only. Preserve all 19 drawings, the three-row layout (4 turnarounds, 8 heads, 7 poses), source otter identity, orange headband, warm rich brown body, cream muzzle and belly, and all poses.
Correct these exact issues:
1. Upper-left turnaround: change ONLY this view into a true straight-on FRONT view, with symmetrical ears/eyes/shoulders and both feet facing the viewer, no 3/4 head tilt. Keep second 3/4 view, third side and fourth back.
2. In EVERY full body drawing, recolor hands AND feet to a solid warm caramel brown visibly LIGHTER than the brown body. They are currently darker; reverse that relationship, while keeping body's rich brown. Clear light paws, including thumbs and waving hands.
3. In middle row sixth head, remove the hand under chin. Thinking must be a HEAD ONLY expression through raised brow and upward gaze. Other middle-row heads unchanged.
4. Seated waiting pose in bottom row fourth: remove the duplicate wristband, leaving exactly one on the character's anatomical right wrist, matching other poses.
5. Make all fills absolutely flat and uniform, no gradients, highlights, textures or shaded volume.
No text, no added characters, no other changes.

Fix the BACKGROUND ONLY of this otter character sheet. Replace all the brown/black blurred background, all halos, glows, vignettes and shadows with a perfectly uniform solid warm off-white #FAF7EF background everywhere between and around the character shapes. The 19 otter drawings must remain intact and fully opaque with sharp clean silhouettes: rich brown bodies, light caramel paws, cream muzzles and bellies, orange headbands and wristbands. Preserve all current poses, expressions, colors, three-row arrangement, exact composition and scale. No gradients or blurry edges anywhere. Do not replace the background with brown. It must be a light ivory paper-colored SOLID background. No text.
